profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer at Fidelity Investments
profile.summary:
I was born in Guadalajara Mexico where I used to live until 7 years back that I relocated to San Antonio Texas in the U.S.

Professionally I have worked for the last 8 years in  USAA and Bank Of America ( current ) 
For the last 4 years I have worked on an agile team that will take care of new development projects and production support on a Backlog priority bases.
 
On my day to day activity I mostly take care of Java J2EE stories, such as the creation and maintenance of EJB 3.0 MDBs, Web services, Rest Services, JPA l, Spring Applications, Spring HIBERNATE , all this in a Websphere 7.0 and 8.5 environments, I am commonly assigned as well to tasks related to Vendor integration stories, Oracle PL SQL, Datastage ETL jobs, Shell Scripting, Netezza Procedures among others.
 
Apart from being developer, I have to manage a team distributed in Guadalajara, Mexico and Hyderabad, India, spreading the communication through daily offshore nightly calls and nearshore same timezone calls and IM communication.
 
Extensive use of the Agile methodology through IBM Rational team concert tools.
 
Used of mostly all the important databases in the market (Oracle, UDB, Sql Server, Netezza, MySQL).

Used of NoSQL with MarkLogic and Hadoop.
 

As my personal life I love to spend time with my wife and my son.. is my main .

Other major interests are going to the gym, traveling, and spending time with my friends.

Love EDM while working, love Netflix series at home, and always trying to learn and read about new technologies..
